query: SELECT cl.id, cl.slug, cl.title, cl.orderIndex, cl.estimatedMinutes, LENGTH(cl.content) as content_length, LEFT(cl.content, 300) as content_preview FROM course_lessons cl JOIN course_modules cm ON cl.moduleId = cm.id WHERE cm.slug = 'fluid-power' ORDER BY cl.orderIndex;
